evidence_excerpts: For fixed excitation level k, the reduced cluster operator contains O(N^k(M-N)^k) terms, and after Jordan-Wigner transformation the preparation problem becomes simulation of a Hamiltonian that is a polynomial sum of Pauli products.
The paper states that no efficient classical implementation of this ansatz has been developed even for low-order cluster operators, while the state may be prepared efficiently on a quantum device.
text: Unitary coupled-cluster ansatz states can be represented with polynomially many reduced cluster terms and are efficiently preparable on quantum hardware despite lacking a known efficient classical implementation.
